end.summary:
Discussed earthworms as animals that live in soil.
Pihu first said earthworms harm plants and called them pests.
They later corrected this and said to gently return earthworms to the soil.
Practised moving leaves gently, observing closely, replacing leaves, and washing hands.
Teach-back was not completed; Pihu ended the lesson because they felt tired.
end.parentNote: Pihu practised how to observe soil animals safely: move leaves gently, look closely, replace the leaves, and wash hands. They first mixed up earthworms with pests, then corrected this later by saying earthworms should be gently returned to the soil. At home, you can ask Pihu to name one safe step for observing an earthworm.
